newsitem.title: USA: Summit Technology to divest Vision Center.
newsitem.headline: Summit Technology to divest Vision Center.

text.p: Summit Technologies Inc on Thursday said it plans to divest, through sale or spin-off its growing but unprofitable Vision Center clinic business to concentrate on its core opthalmic laser systems operations.

"While we are excited about the growth this business is experiencing we have heard our customers concerns about our being directly involved in the same business as they are," said Verne Sharma, Summit chief executive and president.
The Vision Centers will be treated as a discontinued operation from now on, the company said. Summit stock was 1/2 firmer at 7-7/8 at 1000 EST/1500 GMT. ((-- New York Newsrom 212 859 1610))
